resources.string: Ask the native player to select SDR playback instead of HDR.

After enabling, leave and reopen the video so playback selection runs again. Already-playing or preloaded video may retain HDR. An SDR fallback is not guaranteed for HDR-only content. Turning this off restores the native HDR preference; it does not force HDR on. This does not change downloaded files or screen brightness.
